description: This file implements functions for reading thumbstick input from game controllers on UWP platform, including deadzone processing and retrieving current gamepad states.

methods.name: ApplyLinearDeadZone
methods.description: Applies deadzone logic to a single axis value, scaling it into the -1 to 1 range.

methods.name: ApplyStickDeadZone
methods.description: Applies deadzone processing to both X and Y axes of a thumbstick.

methods.name: ReadThumbStick
methods.description: Reads the current thumbstick positions from a Gamepad object, applying deadzone adjustments.

methods.name: GetGamepadThumbSticks
methods.description: Retrieves thumbstick positions from all connected gamepads and stores them in the provided vector.
